indiaContext: A large stock broker exposed millions of investor records through weak access controls. Access control is a configuration decision, and SecuEdge Frontier makes the secure one the default. Supports RBI and SEBI cybersecurity guidelines and the DPDP Act 2023.
customerRef: Our closest references: Kisan Call Centre (government) and Solis Technology (technology).

Yes, with site-to-site VPN on every model.
